description: Defines classes and methods for handling UDP proxying HTTP datagram payloads, including parsing, serialization, and specific payload types for UDP packets and unknown payloads within the quiche project.

classes.name: ConnectUdpDatagramPayload
classes.description: Abstract base class for UDP datagram payloads used in CONNECT-UDP, providing parsing, serialization, and payload access methods.

classes.name: ConnectUdpDatagramUdpPacketPayload
classes.description: Final class representing a UDP packet payload within the UDP datagram, containing the UDP packet data.

classes.name: ConnectUdpDatagramUnknownPayload
classes.description: Final class representing an unknown or unrecognized UDP datagram payload, storing inner payload data.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Static method to parse a wire-format UDP datagram payload into a ConnectUdpDatagramPayload object.

methods.name: GetContextId
methods.description: Returns the context ID associated with the payload.

methods.name: GetType
methods.description: Returns the type of the payload (kUdpPacket or kUnknown).

methods.name: GetUdpProxyingPayload
methods.description: Returns the inner UDP proxying payload as a string view.

methods.name: SerializedLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the payload in wire format.

methods.name: SerializeTo
methods.description: Serializes the payload into a QuicheDataWriter buffer.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the payload into a string buffer.

methods.name: ConnectUdpDatagramUdpPacketPayload
methods.description: Constructor for UDP packet payload, initialized with UDP packet data.

methods.name: ConnectUdpDatagramUnknownPayload
methods.description: Constructor for unknown payload, initialized with context ID and inner payload.
